headline: Corgi Loaf Baking Co.: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. is projected #6 of 16 with a 629.70 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Justin Jefferson, Tyler Warren, and Malik Nabers. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

latest_trade.summary: On July 26, Corgi Loaf Baking Co. traded with Ravens Regime and acquired Tyler Warren, 2026 Round 1 (Ravens Regime), 2028 Round 1 (Ravens Regime) while sending Isaac TeSlaa, Kyle Pitts, 2026 Round 1 (Rapid Valley Annihilation). Tyler Warren is now the current TE starter at 97.1 C-AVI and 90.0 D-AVI; The deal sent out 1 draft asset, reducing future flexibility; The deal added 2 draft assets.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Tyrone Tracy's 48.5 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 54.6 C-AVI would directly attack the 2.20-point projected gap to Ravens Regime.
